# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record relevant checks, including any skipped external prerequisites.

## Operational impact

State any infrastructure, migration, identity or delivery impact. Link updated procedures where needed. Image references must use digests; AWS mutations and workflow activation require explicit authorization.

PR titles use scoped Conventional Commits; commit subjects may omit the scope. The active CI policy requires PRs targeting main to originate from develop.
